purpose: Gate 2 v2: Codex-designed filler-based noncommutativity test. 8 arms per context absorb any additive position/recency model algebraically. Token-length-matched neutral fillers replace same-role controls. Pre-registered gates: (1) TV(AM,MA) > 0.01; (2) excess interaction beyond filler-derived null > 0.01.

_CODEX_DESIGN.key_insight: Same-role controls cannot absorb the discounted-scalar rival s'=lambda*s+delta_u. Filler arms estimate an arbitrary additive slot/recency model and allow algebraic subtraction.
_CODEX_DESIGN.filler_null_model: In additive log-ratio coordinates phi: predicted_phi(AM) = phi(AF_M) + phi(F_AM) - phi(F_AF_M). If actual AM differs from this prediction, there is a genuine interaction beyond position.

pre_registered_gates.gate_1_direct: Lower bound for median TV(AM,MA) > 0.01 (paired, context-stratified)
pre_registered_gates.gate_2_excess: Lower bound for signed order contrast unexplained by filler null > 0.01

interpretation.both_pass: Controlled surface-level noncommutativity; rejects K_a, context-free logit addition, and position-weighted additive decay
interpretation.direct_passes_excess_fails: Ordinary recency/position explains the order effect
interpretation.direct_fails: The selected generators commute within tolerance

estimated_calls: 8 arms x 24 contexts = 192 calls, ~4-5 min CPU
